title: Causal grouped calibration target comparison for residual trust coefficient

provenance.comma_protocol: causal_eval features/physics/targets; route-level groups; dt=0.05 s; stride=15 frames
provenance.nuscenes_protocol: exp_lambda_nusc_causal.collect/gain_causal; CAN speed + backward-difference yaw rate; scene groups; dt=0.02 s; stride=5 frames; all outer test scenes (no TEST_CAP)
provenance.selection_data_flow: fit groups train gain/scaler/MLP; validation groups select lambda only; outer test groups evaluate only
provenance.repeated_draw_handling: average each test group's repeated subset-seed FDE before paired bootstrap
provenance.uncertainty_rule: paired percentile bootstrap over independent test groups, 5000 replicates; Wilcoxon one-sided is supplementary
provenance.conservative_rule: minimize mean validation group FDE + 1.96*SE across validation groups; if fewer than 2 validation groups, transparently falls back to group-mean FDE; empirical only, no guarantee
provenance.lambda_shrinkage_note: kappa=300 and n=overlapping validation anchors are empirical, not effective independent sample size
provenance.test_oracle: not used; no test-selected lambda reported
provenance.comparison_to_canonical: Per-dataset means and first draw records match canonical JSON for all requested N and methods.
provenance.source_cache: External local cache resolved by exp_causal_nuscenes.load; cache not committed.
provenance.validation_status: Do not cite as an independent reproduction. Direct replay of the same canonical draw with current modules does not match its stored test FDE; the apparent script-to-script agreement is insufficient.
